channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Opinion | How is an Annunciation parent to write a Christmas card?
item.description: My hope for the new year is that we each try a little harder to know and understand the stories and experiences of others.

item.title: Takeaways: Wild’s seven-game winning streak ends with 5-1 loss to NHL-best Avalanche
item.description: The Wild also came away without a point at Grand Casino Arena for the first time in 15 home games.

item.title: NDAs, code names and shell companies: How Minnesota officials support data center secrecy
item.description: Governments are signing non-disclosure agreements and concealing basic information about potential data centers.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves do just enough to slip past Bucks
item.description: The Wolves lost Jaden McDaniels to a first-half injury and overcame a 16-point deficit in the second half, thanks to a boost from veterans Mike Conley and Rudy Gobert.

item.title: Phil Esten’s steady leadership takes St. Thomas to new heights
item.description: The Minnesota Star Tribune Sportsperson of the Year led the Tommies to Division I with an intelligent and creative vision.

item.title: Minnesota Hockey Hall of Fame finds home in Inver Grove Heights
item.description: The new complex will include an ice rink and performance hall as well as a museum.

item.title: Scoggins: Biggest loss in J.J. McCarthy’s latest injury? Time to evaluate him.
item.description: The Vikings’ goal for the rest of the season was centered on understanding their young QB’s strengths and weaknesses. Now what?

item.title: Blaze leaves Grace Slavic Church unusable in Eagan
item.description: Congregation relocates services as building suffers extensive fire damage.

item.title: ICE agent fires shots during arrest in St. Paul after being struck with vehicle, agency says
item.description: Two ICE agents were hit by a vehicle during an arrest, according to the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: Analysis: Amid trying week, Vikings gain gritty 16-13 victory over Giants
item.description: A broken team plane. A slew of starters, including QB J.J. McCarthy, felled by injuries. And a three-game win streak for team that continues to fight.
